name: Prestige - Hub Content Draft 2026-08-12
body:
> Plan · Prestige · 2026-08-12

# Summary
This is paste-ready HTML to thicken the two thin hub pages, `/services/` and `/service-areas/`, so they can earn indexing (baseline Problem #3 and part of #1). The file says every price and fact is reused from the live site and nothing is invented. Status in the file: DRAFT, held until the NameHero disk-quota block cleared.

# /services/ hub (about 248 words to about 640)
- Block A, intro prose after the hero: owner-operated by Matt Milunec, flat-rate quoted before work, with price anchors (water heaters from $1,895, tankless from $4,909, drains from $255, hydro jetting $950, water test $125) and same-day in most cases.
- Block B, a 5-question FAQ before the final CTA band: flat-rate pricing, same-day service, services covered, after-hours fee ($125 dispatch), areas served.
- Block C, matching FAQPage JSON-LD for the head.

# /service-areas/ hub (about 179 words to about 620)
- Block A, intro prose: Bluffton home base, about 50 miles of coverage, the same pricebook everywhere with no island upcharge, and local conditions per town (Okatie filtration, Sun City comfort-height toilets and PRVs, Ridgeland wells).
- Block B, an FAQ, and Block C, matching FAQPage schema.

# Status
- The baseline (2026-08-12) still listed "thicken the 2 hubs (draft copy ready)" as pending. No deploy confirmation appears in this folder.
- Note for whoever deploys: the copy uses `—` entities, which conflicts with the no-em-dash house style. Check before pasting.
